correctness.rationale: The radius-one rule after three updates is a seven-letter local predicate; its de Bruijn automaton has 729 six-letter vertices, 1,179 allowed edges. Independently regenerated graph using a separate Kosaraju SCC implementation: a unique cyclic component has 65 vertices and 118 edges. Independently reconstructed all 65 characteristic coefficients by exact trace Newton identities and got λ^61(λ^4−3λ^3+3λ²−λ−1). Closed walks are in bijection with labelled cyclic configurations even for n=3..6, so trace gives all-n recurrence. Opposite direction is spatial reflection; simultaneous satisfaction forces spatial period ≤2, and all six unequal 2-color alternating pairs fail the third iterate, leaving exactly 3 uniform states. F³=S^± implies F^(3n)=Id for each counted state. Independent brute-force dynamics n=3..9 confirmed a_n=(3,7,18,39,73,127,219), both-direction intersection three. Perron–Frobenius of primitive cyclic component yields rho=1.819... and asymptotic 2rho^n.
